name: Aria Laprade
source:
The "Lucky" Girl.
The protagonist of this story.

She had been living a quiet life in the Republic's capital,
but upon receiving an invitation, she finds herself going to Mirage.

Aria strives to maintain a cheerful and positive attitude.
She has a kind and gentle personality, but contrary to her calm appearance, she also has a fearless side.
